mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the FEDFUNDS rate above 4% in the month prior to the decision is associated with a negative 20-day S&P 500 forward return due to expectations of tighter policy and reduced risk appetite.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 4.0 for 3 consecutive months prior to decision
regime_hint: Rising FOMC rates in late-cycle tightening
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically different from a pre-tightening baseline (p > 0.05) or FEDFUNDS does not exceed 4.0 for 3 months prior.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in PAYEMS (labor market additions) of at least 50,000 jobs coincident with a falling UNRATE (unemployment rate) signals labor market strengthening and supports S&P 500 gains over the next 60 days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS > UNRATE * 1.0833 for the current month (i.e., +8.33% job growth vs. unemployment decline)
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns under such a labor signal are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) or the PAYEMS/UNRATE relationship reverses.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly rise in GDPC1 (real private demand) exceeding 2% above the prior quarter's level predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as market anticipates sustained economic momentum.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not statistically positive (p > 0.05) or GDPC1 growth is not above 2% qoq.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in INDPRO (industrial production index) below 100 for three consecutive months indicates supply-side weakness, which is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) or INDPRO recovers above 100 within 20 days.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS falls below 1% for two consecutive months during a low-inflation regime, it predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days as expectations of future rate cuts rise.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS < 1.0 for 2 consecutive months and CPIAUCSL < 102 (inflation target zone)
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) or FEDFUNDS does not remain below 1% for two months.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden drop in UNRATE below 4% accompanied by a 10% one-month decline in HOUST (home sales) predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days due to deflationary and demand-side concerns.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE < 4.0 and HOUST < previous month's value by >10%
regime_hint: Early signs of labor market cooling
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically negative (p > 0.05) or UNRATE does not fall below 4% with the described HOUST decline.

mechanism_narrative: When RSAFS (retail sales) falls for two consecutive months below 100 while INDPRO remains above 105, it signals soft demand without supply shock and is associated with negative 5-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) or INDPRO does not stay above 105.

mechanism_narrative: A regime shift to a high-inflation environment (CPIAUCSL > 105) with no change in FEDFUNDS for two months predicts negative 20-day S&P 500 forward returns as market anticipates policy tightening to curb inflation.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL > 105 and FEDFUNDS unchanged for 2 consecutive months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) or CPIAUCSL does not exceed 105 with the described FEDFUNDS pattern.
